summary: Elevate concurrent authorized same-SKU soft-hold safety so available stock never goes negative and the last unit yields at most one hold, with race losers returning the same named InsufficientStockError as sequential insufficient stock; keep opaque-principal AuthZ (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ); make the property checkable via additive OpenAPI and UML OCL plus a bounded TLA+/TLC model under formal/, without payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, Alloy, durable shared DB productization beyond sample bounds, or rewriting prior lookup/TTL features.
goal: Under concurrent authorized reserves against the same SKU, available stock never goes negative and when only one unit remains at most one reserve creates a soft-hold; race losers fail with InsufficientStockError; OpenAPI, OCL→Vitest, and bounded TLA+/TLC under formal/ make these properties machine-checkable without breaking prior surfaces.
background: Follow-on to done changes add-lookup-available-stock, add-reservation-lookup, and initial-reservation. Sequential insufficient-stock, release, TTL expire, and authorized lookup with availableStock are already checkable; prior briefs deferred formal concurrency (e.g. X8). This change lifts interleaving last-unit / non-negative stock safety into OpenAPI + OCL and Phase 3 bounded TLA+/TLC. Demand, inherited TypeScript/Node + OpenAPI + OCL + Vitest stack, POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ, and out-of-scope themes were settled in Change Context.

in_scope.text: WHEN concurrent authorized opaque principals reserve against the same SKU THEN THE reservation service SHALL keep available stock non-negative for every interleaving
WHEN only one unit of available stock remains and concurrent authorized reserves race for that SKU THEN THE reservation service SHALL create at most one soft-hold

IF an authorized concurrent reserve loses the last-unit (or otherwise insufficient) race THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail with named InsufficientStockError, create no extra hold, and leave losers without a successful reservation

WHILE concurrent reserve paths run THE reservation service SHALL keep opaque-principal AuthZ (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ): unauthorized callers fail with UnauthorizedError and never mutate stock or holds
Additive OpenAPI elevation of reserve insufficient-stock / race-loser channels reusing InsufficientStockError without removing or renaming prior success/error surfaces
Module-level UML OCL with derived Vitest that make InsufficientStockError (including race-loser naming) and non-negative / last-unit checkable properties for sequential and contract-testable paths
Bounded TLA+/TLC model under formal/ (with .cfg) for concurrent last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock, checkable via solid_sdd tools/tla/

out_of_scope.text: Multi-warehouse routing or cross-location inventory allocation
Full IAM product (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) beyond opaque-principal authorize/deny (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)
Notifications (email, push, webhooks) about holds or expiry
Backorders, waitlists, or deferred fulfillment beyond hard-fail when stock is below request
Productizing durable shared persistence across process restarts beyond sample in-process stock and holds
Alloy or other formal languages besides bounded TLA+/TLC under formal/
TTL extend or renewal of an existing soft-hold
List-by-SKU, aggregates, or other multi-hold query surfaces beyond existing get-by-id lookup
Rewriting prior lookup, release, or TTL expire Features beyond keeping them in force while adding concurrent reserve safety
Latency or throughput SLIs/SLOs for concurrent reserves (correctness sample only)

assumptions: Prior Features at requirements/reservation.feature and requirements/reservation-lookup.feature remain in force; this change does not rewrite lookup/release/expire Scenarios except to keep them valid alongside concurrent reserve safety
Race losers reuse the same named InsufficientStockError as sequential insufficient stock — not a new concurrent-only error type
AuthZ continues POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ (opaque-principal allow/deny only; unauthorized → UnauthorizedError, no mutation); do not invent full IAM
Stock and holds remain process-local / in-memory within sample bounds; durable shared DB productization stays out
Prior Brief out_of_scope X8 (formal concurrency deferred) is intentionally lifted here into R7; other prior X* themes remain non-goals
Exact in-process synchronization mechanism (mutex, CAS, queue, etc.) is deferred to implement / ApplicationPlan as long as OpenAPI/OCL/TLA+ properties hold
TLA+ bound parameters (process counts, stock sizes) are deferred to solidsdd-apply-formal / formal cfg and must remain TLC-checkable
Do not invent knowledge ids for concurrency invariants yet; keep them in Brief / Gherkin / contracts until a later harvest gate
constraints: OpenAPI SoT path: openapi/openapi.yaml (additive elevation; reuse InsufficientStockError; do not break prior reserve/release/expire/lookup surfaces)
UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl; derived Vitest under tests/contracts/**
Formal SoT: bounded TLA+ (+ .cfg) under formal/ only; TLC via solid_sdd tools/tla/; no Alloy/other formal SoT
Cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ for AuthZ on concurrent reserve paths; unauthorized must never mutate
Additive non-breaking compatibility (NFR5): prior ops and named errors remain
Contract kind and density choices are deferred to solidsdd-judge; this brief only requires checkable OpenAPI, OCL, and formal surfaces for the concurrency property
Human gate for formal apply is expected later (Phase 3 orchestrator), not at this Brief
ChangeBrief only at this step: no Feature files, WorkPlan, OpenAPI, OCL, formal, tests, or implementation edits as part of brief emission

success_criteria.text: Under concurrent authorized same-SKU reserves, available stock never goes negative for any checkable interleaving
WHEN availableStock is 1 and concurrent authorized reserves race THEN at most one soft-hold is created
Concurrent race losers fail with named InsufficientStockError and create no extra hold
Unauthorized reserve still fails with UnauthorizedError and never mutates stock or holds (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)

openapi/openapi.yaml documents InsufficientStockError (and UnauthorizedError) on reserve additively; contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover insufficient-stock / race-loser naming; formal/**/*.tla (+ .cfg) is TLC-checkable for last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock

open_questions: Exact in-process synchronization mechanism (mutex, compare-and-swap, single-threaded queue, etc.): deferred to implement / ApplicationPlan — non-blocking for Brief scope
Bound parameters for the TLA+ model (process counts, stock sizes): deferred to solidsdd-apply-formal / formal cfg — non-blocking; must remain TLC-checkable

human_gate.reason: Demand (concurrent last-unit safety; non-negative available stock; race-loser InsufficientStockError; OpenAPI + OCL + bounded TLA+/TLC; POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ; additive non-breaking; concrete out-of-scope) was settled in Change Context and the user instruction; Change Context gate required false; open_questions are non-blocking deferrals. Formal apply remains a later Phase 3 human gate, not this Brief.
